ValidationRule.description: Prevents users, that don't have permission, changing status from 'Daon Failed' to either 'Equifax Failed' or 'Equifax Passed'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), NOT( $Permission.ANZx_Edit_COB_Case_Status ), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Fraud_Check", ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Daon Failed"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status, "Equifax Failed" ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Equifax Passed" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change the status from 'Daon Failed' to 'Equifax Failed' or 'Equifax Passed'.
